additional_info.subject: ID0464026-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2/S3314170782001] Billing Discrepancy CRM:03097000247
additional_info.body:
Hi Johannes, good afternoon.
I checked both transactions and the 11.09€ looks completely ok:
Every ~1min30sec there is a DataTransfer request for the RunningCost which is the CaliforniaPricing equivalent of the MeterValues where the cost keeps increasing with the energy delivered. In this line you can see cost = 278 cents and every minute the price is 0.39cent.
At the end of the charging session:
The price is 11.09€ and is sent to the customer.
For the 2nd charging session, there seems to be indeed a problem, at first, the user fails to present the Credit Card many times and eventually gets there:
As you can see here, even though the outlet is authenticated and the session should start, it fails and the user is billed 42 cents.
I am trying to understand where it failed and if it has to do with the fact the user misusage caused some kind of fault in the EcoG because we see the user attempting to start the charge with the credit card 8 times in the space of 6mins.
Is this the only time this sort of behavior happened?
I will get back to you as soon as I have an answer.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: NOTE FROM L3 - Logs from the failed session
ID0464026-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2/S3314170782001] Billing Discrepancy CRM:03097000247
additional_info.body:
Hi Johannes,
I checked with R&D and it seems that we need to reach out to Monta to understand why they sent this value because from our side everything looks ok, in the way that all the failed sessions have the same MeterStart:
So from charger point of view, there was no energy transfer.
Since it seems to be a backend related issue, I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
